refit.rule: for wing points outboard of the cabin (|z| > 0.52 m, inside the wing): z' = z / 1.025 (blended 0.52-0.62 m), x unchanged, y keeps its fraction t of the local FlightGear depth: y' = y_low' + t (y_up' - y_low') of the new wing at (x, z'); points below/above the old skin keep their offset from it
refit.why: the FlightGear wing is 2.5 % too long laterally and ~69 % of the real depth; every system placed on it must move

meta.scaling_note: No depth scaling: the structure is at full real depth inside the new true-dimension wing skin. Tail structure is fitted to FlightGear's stabilizer/fin skins (kept: the manual prints no tail chord or thickness to correct them; tail span 135.14 in vs FlightGear 139.4 in is noted).
notes: LH outer-panel skin has a 26-triangle opening at WS 102.9-116.7 for the FlightGear landing/taxi light lens and recess (moved per data/c172p-wing-objects-refit.json).

Strut: the FlightGear strut (drawn inside the fuselage object) ends at z 2.189 m = WS 86.2 with real stations; the manual's lift-strut station is WS 100.50 (363 mm further out). The fitting follows the FlightGear strut so the existing strut and bolt line up.
